name: GetSiteByPath
description: Retrieves a SharePoint site using its full URL or path via Microsoft Graph API.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Outlook Credential
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate and access SharePoint sites through Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: SitePath
fields.label: Site URL/Path
fields.description: The full URL of the SharePoint site to retrieve (e.g., https://company.sharepoint.com/sites/SiteName).

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the details of the retrieved site including its ID, display name, URL, and other metadata.
